text:
maria_ops: Heads up — Felixstowe dock queue just pushed our H100 inbound by ~36h. Vendor offered partial air uplift but with surcharge. This will affect Dedicated pool capacity next week. :eyes:

nick_procurement: Which AWB/carrier and what surcharge ballpark? Need to know if we absorb or renegotiate price.

lia_logistics: Carrier is OceanicExpress BX-91, AWB 123-4567890. Vendor says air uplift for 4/10 units available, surcharge ~£4k/unit; sea still arrives but +36h. Insurance threshold for terminal damage also changes if we reroute.

vendor_fwd: Confirming — can convert up to 4 units to direct air (2-day transit) for +£4k/unit. Remaining 6 units stay on the vessel (ETA +36h). If you request full air, lead time to rebook is 8h and cost is +£9k/unit. Payment on amended invoice required prior to uplift.

seun_sre: Quick infra question — if we only get 4 earlier, Dedicated pool warmup will be partial. Worst case we lose ~18% throughput for first week while remaining units trickle in. Can we hot-start with A100 nodes (temp) to meet SLAs?

jordan_finance: We need exact numbers for cost impact vs revenue. If surcharge + logistics adds >£20k/week of opcosts, we should pass to customers or delay launch. Nick, can you get a proforma with line items?

maria_ops: Proposal: approve air uplift for 4 units (to hit minimum capacity), accept sea for remaining 6. Ask vendor for RMA pre-labels for DOA units and fast-track customs docs so we don't get stuck in terminal. Lia — confirm insurance claim handling if any units show damage due to congestion. :+1:

lia_logistics: Filed with carrier. AWBs and docs below: \n```\nAWB: 123-4567890 \nAir uplift (tentative rebook ref): AE-7782 \nProforma request ID: RFQ-179-AIRUP\n```\nInsurance note: If we accept partial air, we need to amend consignee declaration — otherwise carrier liability might be limited. I'll coordinate with Legal.

shipmentbot: Carrier update: Felixstowe terminal congestion severity=high; vessel BX-91 berthing delayed 36 hours; ETA revised. Automated ETA patch applied.

vendor_fwd: Understood. Updated proforma attached in the portal (RFQ-179-AIRUP). Surcharge line: "Air uplift — 4 units" = £16,000. Customs brokerage expedite = £1,200. We can issue RMA prelabels once payment confirmation for surcharge received. Net 7 payment OK.

nick_procurement: @vendor_fwd please cc updated invoice to billing@redwood.com and include serials we need for prelabeling. @legal can you quickly confirm if amendment to consignee declaration is required to preserve full insurance?

maria_ops: Approved per above — air for 4, sea for 6, accept surcharge as quoted conditional on vendor issuing RMA prelabels and clearing customs docs. Lia, book pickup window and post back earliest ETA for the 4 air units. I'll update product team about reduced warmup.

lia_logistics: On it — booking pickup window now, will post ETA & tracking within 30m. If Legal flags changes, will hold uplift.

vendor_fwd: Roger. Proforma sent, invoice ref INV-179-UPLIFT. Awaiting PO/payment confirmation.

nick_procurement: Sending PO now. CC'ing finance.

maria_ops: Thanks everyone. Keep thread tight — we need zero surprises on customs/RMA. :ship:
